payload.script:
print("GG_ROUTES_BEFORE=" .. tostring(Session:get_routes():size()))
local tl = Session:new_audio_track(1, 2, ARDOUR.RouteGroup(), 1, "GG_TEST_AUDIO", -1, ARDOUR.TrackMode.Normal, true)
assert(not tl:empty(), "failed to create audio track")
local r = tl:front()
assert(not r:isnil(), "created route is nil")
local p = ARDOUR.LuaAPI.new_plugin(Session, "urn:ardour:a-comp", ARDOUR.PluginType.LV2, "")
assert(not p:isnil(), "ACE Compressor unavailable")
r:add_processor_by_index(p, 0, nil, true)
print("GG_TRACK=" .. r:name())
print("GG_ROUTES_AFTER=" .. tostring(Session:get_routes():size()))
print("GG_PLUGIN_INSERT=PASS")
